response_rows.label: Simple Count Query
response_rows.query: how many total crimes are registered in Karnataka?
response_rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_cases FROM fir_cases

response_rows.label: District-Level Aggregation
response_rows.sql:
SELECT d.district_name, COUNT(*) as case_count
                 FROM fir_cases f
                 JOIN police_stations ps ON f.station_id = ps.station_id
                 JOIN districts d ON ps.district_id = d.district_id
                 GROUP BY d.district_name
                 ORDER BY case_count DESC LIMIT 20

response_rows.label: Crime Type Breakdown
response_rows.sql:
SELECT crime_type, COUNT(*) as case_count FROM fir_cases
                     GROUP BY crime_type ORDER BY case_count DESC

response_rows.label: Crime Trend (multi-year)
response_rows.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', date_of_incident) as year, COUNT(*) as case_count
                     FROM fir_cases GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

response_rows.label: Hotspot Detection (Top 10)
response_rows.sql:
SELECT ps.station_name, d.district_name, COUNT(*) as case_count,
                        AVG(f.severity_score) as avg_severity
                 FROM fir_cases f
                 JOIN police_stations ps ON f.station_id = ps.station_id
                 JOIN districts d ON ps.district_id = d.district_id
                 GROUP BY ps.station_id ORDER BY case_count DESC LIMIT 15

response_rows.label: Accused / Criminal Search
response_rows.query: which accused are wanted repeat offenders?
response_rows.sql:
SELECT a.name, a.age, a.occupation, a.criminal_history, a.arrest_status,
                            COUNT(cr.record_id) as prior_cases
                     FROM accused a
                     LEFT JOIN criminal_records cr ON a.accused_id = cr.accused_id
                     WHERE a.criminal_history > 0
                     GROUP BY a.accused_id ORDER BY prior_cases DESC LIMIT 20

response_rows.label: Victim Statistics
response_rows.sql:
SELECT
                   CASE WHEN v.age < 18 THEN 'Minor (<18)'
                        WHEN v.age < 30 THEN 'Youth (18-29)'
                        WHEN v.age < 50 THEN 'Adult (30-49)'
                        ELSE 'Senior (50+)' END as age_group,
                   v.gender, COUNT(*) as victim_count
                 FROM victims v GROUP BY age_group, v.gender ORDER BY victim_count DESC

response_rows.label: Case Status Breakdown
response_rows.query: show case status breakdown pending vs chargesheet
response_rows.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as case_count FROM fir_cases WHERE status = ? GROUP BY status

response_rows.label: Officer / Station Performance
response_rows.sql:
SELECT o.name, o.rank, ps.station_name, d.district_name, o.cases_handled
                 FROM officers o
                 JOIN police_stations ps ON o.station_id = ps.station_id
                 JOIN districts d ON ps.district_id = d.district_id
                 ORDER BY o.cases_handled DESC LIMIT 20

response_rows.label: Property Crime / Recovery
response_rows.sql:
SELECT property_type, COUNT(*) as items_stolen,
                        SUM(estimated_value) as total_value,
                        SUM(recovered) as recovered_count
                 FROM stolen_property GROUP BY property_type ORDER BY total_value DESC

response_rows.label: Severity Analysis
response_rows.sql:
SELECT f.fir_number, f.crime_type, f.date_of_incident, d.district_name,
                        f.severity_score, f.status
                 FROM fir_cases f
                 JOIN police_stations ps ON f.station_id = ps.station_id
                 JOIN districts d ON ps.district_id = d.district_id
                 WHERE f.severity_score >= 8 ORDER BY f.severity_score DESC LIMIT 25
